title: From Analysis to Report with an Agent
titleZh: 用 Agent 从分析到报告
summary: A challenge course — turn a verified EDA summary into report.json + report.md where every number traces back to its input unchanged.
summaryZh: 一门挑战课程——把经过验证的 EDA 摘要变成 report.json + report.md，其中每个数字都可原样回溯到输入。
outcome: A report generator that produces a machine-readable report.json and a human-readable report.md — the auditable structure that separates “a report exists” from “the numbers are traceable”.
outcomeZh: 一个报告生成器：产出机器可读的 report.json 和人可读的 report.md——把“有份报告”和“数字可回溯”分开的可审计结构。
prerequisites: Python 3.11 or newer available on your PATH
uv or pip to install the pinned pandas dependency
Completing da-eda first is recommended, not required
prerequisitesZh: PATH 中有 Python 3.11 或更新版本
用 uv 或 pip 安装锁定的 pandas 依赖
建议先完成 da-eda，非必需

lessons.title: A report is a contract with the reader
lessons.objective: Trace every number the report must carry back to its source field in results.json.
lessons.objectiveZh: 把报告必须携带的每个数字回溯到 results.json 的来源字段。

lessons.title: Structure before prose
lessons.objective: Decide the skeleton — title, section order, metrics block — before writing any prose.
lessons.objectiveZh: 先定骨架——标题、章节顺序、metrics 块——再写任何文字。

lessons.title: Build and render the report
lessons.objective: Implement the contract in starter/report.py — metrics carried unchanged, sections in order, numbers formatted.
lessons.objectiveZh: 在 starter/report.py 里实现契约——指标原样传递、章节按序、数字格式化。

lessons.title: Numbers traceable to inputs
lessons.objective: Every metric equals its source field — the audit answer is a field name, not an explanation.
lessons.objectiveZh: 每个指标等于来源字段——审计答案是字段名，不是解释。

lessons.title: What report verification cannot see
lessons.titleZh: 报告验证看不到的东西
lessons.objective: The suite checks structure and numbers, not insight or honesty — write the boundary sentence.
lessons.objectiveZh: 套件检查结构与数字，不查洞见与诚实——写下那句边界说明。

scenarios.title: Verified analysis pack
scenarios.blurb: A verified EDA summary that your report must trace, not recompute.
scenarios.blurbZh: 一份已验证的 EDA 摘要——你的报告要回溯它，不是重算它。

verification.method: Six-test contract suite: required headings in order, metrics matching inputs exactly, report files written. The starter must reproduce the unfinished state.
verification.methodZh: 六个测试的契约套件：必需标题按序、指标与输入精确一致、报告文件写出。starter 必须复现未完成状态。
